title: Aspect Ratio
description: Constrains media or content to a stable aspect ratio.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional consumer layout or spacing classes.

responsiveBehavior: Retains touch targets and usable wrapping at 360px.

intentionalDifferences: React follows Radix's 1:1 default ratio; Blade defaults to 16:9. Pass an explicit ratio when cross-framework output must match.

findings.summary: React — Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.detail:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 4.39 (foreground color: #6a7282, background color: #f3f4f6, font size: 10.5pt (14px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1 https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast?application=playwright Retained for the approved visual-parity-first release and explicitly flagged for later token/design remediation.
